summary: Open Text Corp (OTEX) filed an 8-K announcing the completed divestiture of Vertica, a non-core structured data analytics platform, to Rocket Software Inc. (a Bain Capital portfolio company) for US$150 million in cash. The transaction, consistent with OpenText's non-core divestiture strategy, closed on May 11, 2026. Net proceeds will be used to reduce outstanding debt. No further terms, premium, or advisors were disclosed. As a closed transaction, the filing is confirmatory; watch for potential restructuring or future capital allocation updates.
